description: Header file for Eeprom (Eep) module in AUTOSAR platform, defining types, error codes, function prototypes, and configuration includes for EEPROM operations.

methods.name: Eep_Init
methods.description: Initializes the EEPROM module with the provided configuration.

methods.name: Eep_Erase
methods.description: Erases a specified EEPROM address range.

methods.name: Eep_Write
methods.description: Writes data to a specified EEPROM address.

methods.name: Eep_GetStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the EEPROM module.

methods.name: Eep_GetJobResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the last EEPROM job.

methods.name: Eep_MainFunction
methods.description: Main function to handle EEPROM tasks.

methods.name: Eep_Read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified EEPROM address.

methods.name: Eep_Compare
methods.description: Compares EEPROM data with a target buffer.

methods.name: Eep_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the EEPROM module.
